mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_LOGIN_HIST ( LOGIN_SEQ, USER_ID, LOGIN_DT, LOGIN_IP, LOGIN_RESULT, FAIL_REASON, USER_AGENT ) VALUES ( SEQ_T_LOGIN_HIST.NEXTVAL, #{userId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{loginIp,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{loginResult,jdbcType=CHAR}, #{failReason,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{userAgent,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.update: UPDATE T_LOGIN_HIST SET LOGOUT_DT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE LOGIN_SEQ = ( SELECT LOGIN_SEQ FROM ( SELECT LOGIN_SEQ FROM T_LOGIN_HIST WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND LOGIN_RESULT = 'S' AND LOGOUT_DT IS NULL ORDER BY LOGIN_DT DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1 )
